summary: This is a routine earnings press release filed by Grupo Simec on Form 6-K, reporting its first-quarter 2026 financial results. The filing presents year-over-year comparisons of net sales, cost of sales, gross profit, operating income, and EBITDA. There is no mention of any acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or abrupt management change. The content is purely operational and financial performance reporting, with no special-situation event. This Form 6-K serves as an equivalent to a routine quarterly earnings release for a foreign private issuer.
